items.title: Merck Stock Nearly Doubled Without A Change In Its Revenue Growth
items.summary: Merck (MRK) stock returned about 87% over the past twelve months, climbing from roughly $79 to about $147. Nothing in the year's results looks like that. The medicines Merck sells today grew at their usual pace. Investors spent the year repricing what comes next.

items.title: Pfizer’s Dividend Yield Is Enormous. But Is the Payout Still Growing?
items.summary: Pfizer has raised its dividend every year for over a decade, then something changed. Before you count on that 6% yield, find out what the payout's own behavior is quietly signaling about the company's financial confidence.

items.title: Can Volume Keep Covering Eli Lilly's Price Cuts?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (LLY) grew revenue 48% in Q2 2026, driven by Zepbound and Mounjaro. A more understated metric for investors to watch is pricing. Lilly's U.S. price fell 9% from a year earlier, excluding changes to rebate estimates. So far, volume covers that cut. The risk is the quarter it cannot.
